scope: BTCUSDT Spot 1d; event census 2019-01-01..2021-12-31; 2018 history for lagged RV; 2022-01 horizon tail only

matching.feature: 20-day realized volatility from strictly prior completed daily log returns
matching.decile: trailing empirical decile using up to 252 strictly prior valid RV20 observations; no forward outcome enters matching
matching.pool: same calendar year, same grid family, same direction convention, clean raw non-event dates with valid 10D horizon
matching.assignment: minimum absolute decile distance; ties earliest unused date; one comparator date per event within each grid

terminal_rule: PRIMARY only: SUPPORT iff paired event-minus-comparator median signed return > 0 at both 5D and 10D, event win fraction > comparator at both 5D and 10D, and event median MAE is no worse (>= comparator median MAE) at both 5D and 10D. HALF is sensitivity only and cannot rescue PRIMARY.
